- Gallery: the photo viewer's zoom is written again from the start. The page's zoom arithmetic is one small class (where the picture lies: its zoom and its move, never beyond the page's edges), and the picture is drawn straight onto a canvas at the place it gives, no longer through a scaled layer. Two fingers zoom and move the picture, one finger moves it only while zoomed (at the whole picture the pager turns the page), a double tap or the zoom button zooms in on the point touched and back out, a long press or the chip plays a LIVE picture. The zoom goes up to the level set in the settings (never less than 4x). The picture is read once at 2048 px on its long edge.
- Game Hub: closing an open case (Back) left a black screen: the case flew back into its box only as fast as the phone's graphics chip drew it, and when it did not, the case stayed over the shelf. In Pulse the case now closes at once and the shelf with the box is back straight away; the case's 3D drawing is let go eight seconds later when it is not opened again, freeing its graphics memory.
- Game Hub: the 3D case was slow: on the Low level (the one Pulse runs on) the disc's see-through glass was still on, so the whole scene was drawn twice every frame. It is off now, the case uses plain materials (no clear coat or rainbow sheen) and no multisampling; measured on a software renderer the case went from about 7 to about 30 frames a second.
- Game Hub: browsing the shelf stuttered: the hidden screens (the open case, the disc going in) were still kept by the graphics chip as whole-screen layers, and every case had its own moving shine layer. Hidden screens are no longer drawn and the shine is left out on Low; the layers kept went from about 11 screens' worth to under 7.
